terms.comment: Our transparent description: a castle made from sand; castellum, castellī n. No reference work has a word for a sandcastle.

phrases.latin: Castellum ex harēnā exstruāmus; cape situlam et pālam.
phrases.english: Let’s build a sandcastle; get your bucket and spade.

phrases.latin: illī in lītoribus harēnae congestū simulācra domuum excitant
phrases.english: the children, on the beach, heap up sand and raise make-believe houses
to build little houses, to harness mice to a toy cart
